newsitem.title: DENMARK: Unibank arranging CMOs of total 1.4 billion DKK.
newsitem.headline: Unibank arranging CMOs of total 1.4 billion DKK.

text.p: Denmark's Unibank said on Tuesday that it was arranging four series of Collateralised Mortgage Obligations (CMOs) to a total of 1.4 billion crowns.
It said that Collateralised Mortgage Obligations Denmark A/S would issue the paper on July 10.
CMOs are packages of mortgage-backed bonds which are split into different risk categories or tranches according to investors' wishes. --Soeren Linding Jakobsen, Copenhagen newsroom +45 33969653
